recalls.component: FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
recalls.summary: General Motors, LLC. (GM) is recalling certain 2021 Cadillac XT5, XT6, and GMC Acadia vehicles.  The fuel supply lines may be improperly attached and seated.

recalls.component: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
recalls.summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2020-2021 Cadillac XT5, XT6, and GMC Acadia vehicles equipped with the optional Surround Vision feature.  The rearview camera coaxial cable connectors may have been crimped improperly, causing the rearview camera to fail or function intermittently.

source: NHTSA (api.nhtsa.gov) — complaints and recalls by vehicle
